text: Bulk upload historical persons and transactions data through a CSV data upload endpoint
quote: Upload historical persons and transactions data using CSV data upload endpoint.

text: Push new persons and transactions automatically through addPerson and addTransaction API endpoints
quote: Configure client application to upload new persons and transactions automatically using addPerson endpoint and addTransaction endpoint.

text: Webhooks notify the client application of events such as new alerts or changes to a person's risk level
quote: Configuring a webhook will cause Salv to notify client application about a particular event, for example about a creation of a new alert or change of a risk level for any person.

text: Downloadable OpenAPI (YAML) definition of the public API that can be imported into Postman
quote: API definition to import into Postman can be downloaded at https://docs.salv.com/api/public.yaml

text: API tokens are issued through the OAuth2 client credentials flow
quote: We use OAuth2 client credentials flow to issue our API tokens.

text: API tokens can be revoked in the UI by deleting the client credentials that generated them
quote: An API token can be invalidated using Salv UI by deleting the client credentials that were used to generate the token.

text: Separate sandbox (demo) environment alongside production
quote: Select environment: * `app` - Production * `demo` - Sandbox

text: Update endpoints apply partial updates, changing or adding only the attributes provided in the request
quote: A request to this endpoint will only update or add attributes which are provided in the request.

text: Some configuration, such as Custom Lists, can be managed through the open API
quote: some of the configuration is available in open API as well: Custom Lists

text: Transaction monitoring checks can run in real time, returning the answer in the API response so the payment can be held; this is chosen per scenario
quote: Choose per scenario. Real-time returns an answer inside the API response, so your system can hold the payment

text: API endpoints to update alert status and to create and update manual alerts
quote: Alerts: Update alert status. Manual Alerts: Create manual alert, Update manual alert

text: Fetch a person's risk factors through the API
quote: Risks: Fetch person risk factors

text: Payments are screened in real time, with the decision returned in the API response while the payment is in flight
quote: Payments are screened in real time: your system makes the call and gets the decision back in the response, while the payment is still in flight.

text: Incident updates and maintenance status messages are delivered in Slack
quote: Get incident updates and maintenance status messages in Slack.

text: Matching is set per field: fuzzy matching with a configurable threshold for names, exact matching for identifiers like account numbers
quote: Choose matching per field: fuzzy for names, where spelling varies, with a threshold you set; exact for an account number

text: Draft a screening flow, run it against your own history with different settings, and preview the alerts it would raise before going live
quote: Draft a flow, run it against your own history with different settings, and see the alerts it would have raised before it goes live.

text: Good-listing remembers matches the team has already cleared, keyed on identifiers you choose
quote: Good-listing remembers matches your team has already cleared, keyed on identifiers you choose.

text: Clearance rules, from a library or custom-built, auto-close alerts that meet set conditions and keep each auto-closed alert as an audit trail
quote: Clearance rules close alerts that meet conditions you set, from the library or your own, and every auto-closed alert stays on the record as an audit trail.

text: AI-Powered Insights adjudicates name matches and explains its reasoning, but is informational only and never closes alerts
quote: AI-Powered Insights adjudicates a name match and explains its reasoning, but it's informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision.

text: Screening entries are normalised and cleaned, with transliteration for Cyrillic, Greek and Traditional Chinese
quote: Entries are normalised and cleaned first, and transliteration covers Cyrillic, Greek and Chinese (Traditional).

text: Customers are screened at onboarding, re-screened automatically several times a day as lists change, and screened on demand through the API
quote: Customers are screened at onboarding, then re-screened automatically several times a day as lists change, and on demand through the API.

text: Resolve sanctions hits that involve another bank directly with the counterparty through bank-to-bank clearance in Salv Bridge
quote: When a hit involves another bank, settle it with the counterparty directly through Salv Bridge, using bank-to-bank sanctions clearance.

text: Monitoring scenarios start from a library and can be adjusted by type, threshold and segment, or written from scratch
quote: Start from the library and adjust each scenario's type, threshold and segments, or add your own alongside them.

text: An alert suppression interval stops a repeating customer from re-alerting every day
quote: Set an alert suppression interval so a repeating customer doesn't re-alert every day.

text: Backtest any scenario version against up to a year of your own history without creating real alerts
quote: Run any scenario version against up to a year of your own history, with no real alerts, and see what it would have caught

text: Counterparties are monitored as well, surfacing clean-looking customers who pay suspicious counterparties
quote: Counterparties are monitored too, so a customer who looks clean but pays a suspicious counterparty still surfaces.

text: Monitoring deploys as cloud, private cloud or on-premise
quote: Salv Monitoring deploys as cloud, private cloud or on-premise.

text: Cases group related alerts, customers and transactions and are worked with notes, documents, an assignee and a status
quote: Open a case, attach the related alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status

text: An open case is shown on every customer, counterparty, payment and alert it touches
quote: The case then shows on every customer, counterparty, payment and alert it touches, so anyone opening that customer sees the investigation already under way.

text: A customer change made in one tool is reflected across all Salv tools
quote: A customer change in one tool is reflected across all of them.

text: Salv Bridge connects financial crime teams at member institutions through structured requests that a person answers
quote: Salv Bridge connects financial crime teams at member institutions directly, through structured requests answered by a person

text: Joint screening of new customers against a shared pool of onboarding fraudsters known to other banks
quote: Onboarding fraudsters other banks know Joint screening of new customers against a shared pool
